column1: # Game profile of Metroid Prime Remastered (Switch, 1.0.0 = v0). Plays on the Mac (boot, the title, the menus, a new game's opening and the Frigate Orpheon)
# Retro Studios' engine (RFRM forms, little-endian unlike Tropical Freeze's: MaterialArchive.arc and .pak archives) on SDK 12.3.1, NVN; subsdk0 is the SDK's movie library.
# Its shaders are SNVN program records in MaterialArchive.arc, in the packs' MTRL resources and in a startup archive LZSS-compressed into main (shader_split.py rfrm_shaders /
# retro_main_forms). What the host and chain needed for it is general (README.md: the PIXLD sample index, GLSLC's sample position table, image stores under rasterizer discard)

# Game name: only a label for profile listings and the Mac window title; the iOS app name is the game name in the base NSP, and the bundle ID comes from the base game title ID (build_ipa.sh / NSP script)
# no system resource: nninitStartup binary-searches SetMemoryHeapSize from 4.5 GB down and settles on 3.11 GB in the 4 GB layout's 3.25 GB heap region, as Tropical Freeze does;
# about 2.7 GB resident and 2.4 GB of Metal allocations on the Frigate Orpheon on the Mac
# the NPDM declares 0 MB of system resource: IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false, as on Horizon
# 40,483 shaders (20,233 vertex, 20,233 pixel, 12 geometry, 5 compute): MaterialArchive.arc, the MTRL resources of the world, preload and UI packs, and the startup archive in main;
# the rewritten modules are larger than the default 64 MB of used memory
